# Tech&Res politics: values of the post-1936 movements - GENERATED by .claude/skills/ztr_politics/scripts/ztrpol_gen_movements.py

# Country scope: share of generated pollution left after the national reductions of the global warming JE.
# Mirrors ztr_global_warming_apply_country_pollution_reductions, which only runs with climate disasters enabled
ztrpol_pollution_reduction_mult = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_basic_protection }
		multiply = 0.95
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_active_restoration }
		multiply = 0.9
	}
	if = {
		limit = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_environmental_policy value >= 5 } }
		multiply = 0.75
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_environmental_policy value >= 4 } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_environmental_policy value >= 3 } }
		multiply = 0.85
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_environmental_policy value >= 2 } }
		multiply = 0.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_environmental_policy value >= 1 } }
		multiply = 0.95
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_mining_restrict_hazardous }
		multiply = 0.98
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_mining_strategic }
		multiply = 0.95
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_polluting_mining_banned }
		multiply = 0.9
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_technology_researched = urban_sustainability }
		multiply = 0.9
	}
}

# State scope: pollution generated per million inhabitants, after national reductions
ztrpol_state_pollution_per_million = {
	value = pollution_generation
	multiply = owner.ztrpol_pollution_reduction_mult
	divide = { # Population in millions first, to stay within fixed-point range; at least 100k against tiny mining states
		value = state_population
		divide = 1000000
		min = 0.1
	}
	min = 0
}

# Country scope: same ratio over all its states
ztrpol_country_pollution_per_million = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = {
		add = pollution_generation
	}
	multiply = ztrpol_pollution_reduction_mult
	divide = {
		value = total_population
		divide = 1000000
		min = 0.01
	}
	min = 0
}
